hypotheses.summary: Every one of 273 spans reports status OK and 0 log records are at ERROR — including the spans that retried against a throttling provider and the ones that sent a duplicate. Meanwhile 4 accepted messages never reached a provider. Any alert, SLO, or dashboard built on span status or log level shows this pipeline as healthy through every incident in this window. A dropped message produces no error at all — only an absence of spans, and absence pages nobody.
